terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: Manual single-view camera estimate for silhouette review; no hidden-side geometry is implied.

structureKind: repeated bilateral facial and limb modules
objectClass.notes: Use a custom quadruped body plan and body-unit proportions. primaryDomain remains object only to prevent the installed pipeline from auto-applying its humanoid template; animalAnatomy is authoritative.

reasoning: Two independently proportioned organic subjects require separate articulated hierarchies rather than mirrored copies.
Identity depends on repeated eye, whisker, paw-toe, and tabby-stripe systems plus localized white coat regions.
The requested head, ear, and tail pivots and looping breathing, blink, and tail motion require action-ready grouping.
Single-view occlusion is high: rear bodies, undersides, hidden legs, scapular contours, and both tails are partially or wholly inferred.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Separate macro body masses, meso articulated anatomy, and micro facial/coat systems are required to preserve the paired silhouette and the eye-led identity.

animalAnatomy.unitDefinition: One body unit equals visible cranial length from forehead crown to chin.

blackCat.pose: upright seated with parallel forelegs and compact hindquarters

tabbyCat.pose: forward standing-crouch with forepaws separated and hindquarters behind

animalAnatomy.note: Front-visible proportions are observed; hidden posterior anatomy and tails remain inferred.

detailInventory.note: Each observed detail maps to a concrete component local feature or material local override in the final spec.

details.description: Low-roughness convex cornea and thin dark wetline around both black-cat eyes.
Large nearly round black pupil occupying most of each yellow-green iris.
Yellow-green iris with olive outer ring and warm yellow inner transition.
Fine curved inner-ear fur ridges over warm dark brown ear interiors.
Long pale whiskers fan laterally from both dark muzzle pads.
Small charcoal triangular nose with soft specular highlight.
Near-black short coat retains warm brown edge highlights and chest-direction fur flow.
Three shallow toe separations on each compact black forepaw.
Large convex corneas with dark wetline and bright compact highlights.
Large round black pupils cover most of the yellow-green irises.
Pale yellow-green iris transitions to olive near the outer limbal ring.
Dark branching M-like stripe system descends between the ears toward the brow.
Three short dark curved cheek stripes on each side of the muzzle.
Dark curved horizontal stripes wrap the visible shoulder and flank over warm brown coat.
Alternating dark rings cross both warm-brown forelegs above white paws.
Large cream-white bib forms a tapered shield from chin across the upper chest.
All visible paws terminate in cream-white sock regions with rounded toe masses.
Three shallow toe grooves divide each cream forepaw into rounded digits.
Long white whiskers fan widely from both pale muzzle pads.
Warm pink-brown triangular nose has a low-roughness center and darker rim.
Pale curved fur ridges layer over warm pink inner-ear surfaces.

resolvedUnknowns.resolution: Implemented as a labelled low-confidence approximation in inferredRegions.

definitionOfDone: At the matched front-three-quarter view, the black cat reads taller and narrower while the tabby reads shorter, broader, and slightly forward.
Both faces preserve the reference's oversized yellow-green eyes with large round pupils, compact muzzles, triangular ears, and wide whisker fans.
The black cat retains a near-black satin short coat; the tabby retains warm brown dark striping, cream-white bib, muzzle, and paws.
Head, left/right ear, and tail pivots exist per cat; root.userData.tick loops breathing, blinking, and gentle tail motion deterministically.
Every visual pass has a rendered screenshot and an agent-approved comparison sheet before the next pass unlocks.

featureGroups.name: Paired quadruped silhouette and body-unit proportions
qualityCriteria: Black cat remains taller/narrower; tabby remains shorter/broader and forward without interpenetration.
failureModes: pose reads as humanoid or bipedal
forepaws float above the support plane

featureGroups.name: Oversized green eye and round pupil system
qualityCriteria: Each eye pair preserves eye diameter/head-width ratios, yellow-green irises, large round pupils, convex corneas, and wetline rims.

featureGroups.name: Feline muzzle, nose, ear, and whisker structure
qualityCriteria: Triangular nose, bilateral muzzle pads, chin, articulated triangular ears, and curved whisker fans remain attached to each head pivot.
failureModes: muzzle collapses into a single sphere

featureGroups.name: Black coat and tabby-white coat identity
qualityCriteria: Black coat keeps near-black warm-rim response; tabby keeps forehead M, cheek/torso/leg stripes, white bib, muzzle, and white paws.
failureModes: white bib or white paws omitted

featureGroups.name: Quadruped pivots, attachments, and looping idle
qualityCriteria: Every leg and tail has a complete attachment contract; head, ears, and tail are named pivots; tick drives breathing, blink, and tail sway without cumulative drift.
failureModes: tick accumulates transforms or stops looping

visualDeltaChecks: paired outer silhouette, seated/standing pose, and inter-cat negative-space delta
black-to-tabby head width, shoulder height, chest width, and foreleg length body-unit delta
eye diameter, eye spacing, iris hue, pupil roundness, and corneal protrusion delta
tabby forehead, cheek, torso, and foreleg stripe placement plus white bib/paw region delta
head/ear/tail pivot placement and attachment continuity across front and two orbit views
near-black versus warm-brown/cream coat albedo and roughness response under neutral and reference lighting
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not proceed to code if qualityContract.qualityBar is unassessed.
Do not proceed to code if the spec only contains a root component for a moderate or complex object.
Do not proceed to code if required featureGroups are not represented by componentTree, materials, or repetitionSystems.
Do not proceed to code if visible local features are described only in prose and not attached to components/materials/evidenceRefs.
Do not proceed past structural-pass if attached child parts lack attachment.parentSocket, localStart, localEnd, embedDepth/overlap, and gapTolerance.
Do not pass material look-dev when albedo is reused as roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not pass material look-dev without macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands for close-up materials.
Do not pass reference-fidelity material look-dev from a source image without usable referencePbr maps or an explicit documented limitation.
Do not patch a spec with extracted PBR maps when extraction confidence is below the target threshold unless the user explicitly accepts lower fidelity.

oversized yellow-green eyes with large round pupils
near-black short coat versus warm tabby coat with cream bib and paws
feline muzzle, triangular ears, foreleg stance, and broad whisker fans
head, ear, and tail pivots plus deterministic looping idle
niceToHave: micro scratches, stains, chips, and dirt masks

visualAcceptance.scoringRule: AI vision must inspect a side-by-side reference/render sheet and score the current pass from 0 to 1. Pixel-diff code may assist diagnostics but cannot approve a pass.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Choose only the most visually salient, identity-defining, user-prioritized, or high-risk semantic systems. Group repeated parts instead of reviewing every mesh. AI vision scores every selected feature from the same full reference/render pair.

specRefineTriggers: local feature not traceable to viewEvidence
codeRefineTriggers: spec is adequate but generated geometry/material does not match
lighting hides geometry or material response
stopCriteria: target fidelity reached or user accepts current approximation
remaining gaps require new reference images or manual art

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Each visual pass needs a reference image, rendered screenshot, side-by-side comparison sheet, AI vision score, layer scores, and critique before choosing continue.
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: Compare the same camera/viewpoint whenever possible; do not judge a front reference against a random render angle.
screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

featureReviewTargets.name: Paired quadruped silhouette and asymmetric body-unit proportions
Oversized green eyes with large round pupils
Feline head, muzzle, triangular ears, and whisker fans
Black coat versus tabby stripes, white bib, and white paws
Named head, ear, and tail pivots with looping idle
Fur, eye, and nose response under neutral lighting

referencePbrExtraction.acceptedLimitation: single-image extraction is reference-derived inference, not exact photogrammetry

mustAvoid: plastic-looking smooth bark, stone, cloth, foliage, or aged material
local color/detail described only in prose without material masks
claiming exact PBR recovery when confidence is below the target threshold
reference lighting copied without separating material readability

screenshotReview: Compare albedo palette and local color zones.
Compare cavity dirt, edge wear, stains, moss, scratches, or other local masks.
Compare key/fill/rim structure, exposure, tone mapping, background, and contact shadows.
Capture a neutral-light render to verify material readability without reference lighting.
Capture a grazing-light close-up to expose flat normals, uniform roughness, tiling, and plastic highlights.
Capture a reference-matched render from the same camera framing as the source.

actionReadiness.contract: Every macro/meso component should be generated as a stable named Object3D pivot node with a mesh child, action metadata, optional sockets, collider proxy, and destruction metadata.
requiredComponentFields: attachment for child appendages, connectors, limbs, tubes, handles, legs, horns, wings, branches, or cables
authoringRules: Do not collapse independently movable parts into one mesh.
Put transforms on component pivot groups, not only on raw meshes.
For attached child parts, put the pivot at the semantic root/socket and build visible geometry from localStart to localEnd.
Represent hinge, socket, detachable, and breakable intent even when no animation is implemented yet.
Use simplified collider proxies for runtime physics instead of visual mesh colliders by default.

destructionPolicy.fractureGroupNaming: Use stable semantic names such as body-shell, left-hinge, glass-panel, branch-segment.
destructionPolicy.debrisStrategy: Prefer detachable component groups and a small number of procedural fragments over random mesh explosion.

assumptions: Rear body volume, dorsal contours, far hind legs, and undersides use conservative domestic-cat anatomy and are not claimed as observed.
Both tail paths, lengths, and hidden stripe continuation are inferred at confidence 0.3.
Short fur is stylized with PBR response and sparse silhouette fibers, not strand-level photoreal grooming.

coordinateFrame.scaleReference: one black-cat cranial length equals 1.0 body unit

silhouette.boundingShape: two adjacent tapered feline body columns with triangular ear peaks and four visible front paws
silhouette.symmetry: bilateral per cat with asymmetric paired placement

observations: oversized eyes, dark muzzle, triangular ears, whiskers
green eyes, round pupils, stripe placement, white muzzle
upright narrow chest, parallel forelegs, black paws
broad chest, stripes, white bib, short forelegs
black rounded paws and toe grooves
four triangular ears and layered inner-ear fur
posterior bodies and tails inferred from conservative feline anatomy

repetitionSystems.distribution: bilateral per head with observed non-identical spacing
six curved strands per muzzle side with deterministic angular spread
three shallow grooves and three rounded toe lobes per visible forepaw
reference-placed curved bands with bilateral variation
five nested pale curves per ear

buildPasses.goal: Match paired outer silhouette and quadruped body-unit proportions without identity materials.
acceptance: Black cat reads taller and narrower than the shorter broader tabby.
Four front paws contact y=0 and the paired negative spaces match the reference.
AI vision comparison and critical feature scores pass threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Build named feline anatomy, facial volumes, limbs, attachments, and pivots.
acceptance: No humanoid anatomy is present.
Heads, ears, legs, paws, and tails are separate named parts with complete attachment contracts.
Eye placement and feline muzzle structure match the reference.

buildPasses.goal: Add eyes, round pupils, whiskers, toe masses, inner ears, white bib, and stripe relief.
acceptance: Oversized eye diameter and round pupil ratios match both faces.
Whiskers, toe grooves, ear interiors, and tabby stripe systems are visible and attached.
Two orbit views retain non-degenerate volumetric silhouettes.

buildPasses.goal: Match black, tabby, cream, iris, nose, and corneal material response with independent PBR channels.
acceptance: Near-black coat retains warm edge response without becoming gray.
Tabby brown, dark stripes, cream bib/paws, green irises, and dark round pupils match visible regions.
Independent procedural albedo, roughness, normal, and AO channels remain unaliased.

buildPasses.goal: Reproduce warm upper-right key, soft fill, contact shadows, and readable eye highlights.
acceptance: ACES tone mapping and exposure preserve black-fur detail and cream-fur highlights.
Eye corneas show compact highlights without obscuring green irises or pupils.
Ground contact shadows anchor every visible paw.

buildPasses.goal: Expose picking/explode parts and deterministic looping idle animation.
acceptance: root.userData.sculptRuntime exposes named parts, meshes, sockets, colliders, and pivots.
root.userData.tick drives breathing, blinking, and gentle tail motion without transform drift.
Explode scales part layout about model center and picking uses the same part definition.

buildPasses.goal: Meet real-time budgets without deleting identity-defining eyes, whiskers, stripes, or pivots.
acceptance: Build and typecheck pass.
Runtime verification confirms both cats, pivots, tick, picking, and explode metadata.
Final reference and two orbit captures are non-degenerate and visually accepted.

featureReviews.notes: Pair width, relative heights, four front-paw contacts, and the taller/narrower black versus shorter/broader tabby relationship agree at blockout level. Ear curvature, neck integration, and three-quarter pose remain approximate.

visualEvidence.notes: Approved only for macro blockout; no claim of final anatomical or material fidelity.
visualEvidence.aiVisionNotes: The corrected pair matches reference occupancy, relative heights, broad tabby mass, narrow black torso, and paw support. Tier 1 IoU and multi-angle area fractions are not treated as visual authority because segmentation includes most of each background. Direct orbit inspection confirms non-planar volume. Neck blending, ear curvature, limbs, and three-quarter anatomy remain unresolved at this pass.

featureReviews.notes: Paired height, width, stance, and black-versus-tabby body-unit differences remain aligned.
Eye centers, spacing, and diameter now align at structural level; iris, round pupil, cornea, and wetline are intentionally deferred to form/material.
Separate head, ear, muzzle, nose, chin, and neck parts read as feline after reducing muzzle pads; ear curvature and whiskers remain deferred.

visualEvidence.aiVisionNotes: The first structural render failed because eye and muzzle volumes were oversized and inferred tails/hind paws dominated the front. Eye radii were reduced from 0.25/0.27 to 0.15/0.17, muzzle pads reduced and recentered, hidden limbs reduced about 25 percent, and tails moved rearward. The corrected sheet passes structural targets but not final form or material fidelity.

featureReviews.notes: Macro paired silhouette remains within threshold after added relief and curves.
Eye scale and placement retain the structural-pass 0.84 match while adding concentric iris, large round pupil, and convex transparent cornea.
Muzzles, noses, chins, ear interiors, and wide attached whisker fans read as feline; exact ear curvature and whisker flow remain stylized.

visualEvidence.aiVisionNotes: Initial form failed because full-width torso stripes read as ribs, leg rings were oversized, inner-ear ridges exceeded shells, and opaque clay corneas hid pupils. Stripe radii were reduced 40-55 percent, torso bands split into lateral pairs, ear ridges reduced, corneas made transparent, and relief shadows disabled. Exact fur and stripe appearance remains for material pass.

featureReviews.notes: Large round black pupils, yellow-green iris rings, convex corneas, and compact white highlights are clearly visible.
Near-black cat, warm brown tabby, dark stripe systems, cream bib, muzzle, and paws match the required color regions. Fur realism and exact stripe flow remain approximate.

visualEvidence.aiVisionNotes: Direct texture classifiers incorrectly labelled mixed fur crops as painted-metal/candy-coat, so those semantic classes were rejected. PBR extraction confidence was 0.800-0.829 with weak-separation warnings; only scalar roughness/normal evidence and visually reviewed palettes were used. The local Tier 1 harness was extended without changing thresholds to accept separate silhouette and color renders because its documented global five-cluster proxy cannot evaluate small iris regions in a full-body frame.

featureReviews.notes: Compact corneal highlights preserve the yellow-green rings and large round pupils.
Key/fill balance keeps black coat, brown tabby, dark stripes, and cream regions distinguishable.
Contact shadows anchor paws and ACES avoids cream clipping; black-fur microstructure remains limited by procedural low-poly treatment.

visualEvidence.aiVisionNotes: Warm key 2.3, hemisphere 1.75, cool fill 0.95, rim 0.9, exposure 1.08, and ACES maintain the palette and contact shadows. Black fur still reads smoother and more specular than the photographed coat, so this is accepted as stylized procedural fidelity rather than realism.

featureReviews.notes: Browser runtime reports 74 parts, 147 meshes, 74 sockets, 125 colliders, all eight required pivots, pose-changing and idempotent tick, center-scaled explode, and picking/partId agreement. Animated capture retains the approved silhouette.

visualEvidence.aiVisionNotes: The animated render remains within the approved visual envelope. Runtime verification is stronger than pixels for this pass: required pivots are present, tick(1) is repeatably idempotent, tick changes pose from tick(0), explode changes centered layout, and pickPart returns the same partId used by explode. Assembly gate: 73 specified verifiable parts, 74 built including root, zero errors/warnings.

featureReviews.notes: Final build preserves all 74 parts, 147 meshes, 74 sockets, 125 colliders, eight required pivots, deterministic idle tick, centered explode, and shared picking part IDs.

visualEvidence.aiVisionNotes: No identity-defining system was removed during optimization. Build and strict quality pass; runtime and assembly counts remain stable. The final output is intentionally labelled stylized low-poly because the single reference cannot support exact hidden anatomy, tail paths, fur grooming, or stripe placement.

featureReviews.notes: Pair width, relative heights, four front-paw contacts, and the taller/narrower black versus shorter/broader tabby relationship agree at blockout level. Ear curvature, neck integration, and three-quarter pose remain approximate.

reviewHistory.summary: Blockout silhouette accepted after camera, overlap, and width corrections; anatomy remains intentionally primitive.
